requirement: Ops Templates: Create listing drafts the release top-level pages, Road to live Listing asks a listing to cover them without system pages, and the Design Inspiration tab draws on first open

oracle.invariant: Create listing on Tracy Base EmDash drafts Home, Product, Service /services, Pricing, Resources /blog and Company /about though the demo menu read Home alone. The draft never carries a system page, a not found page, a language root or a legal page, and breaks no rule of its own. tracy-business j6 is flagged for Terms · Privacy, Русский and Not found; ja-social-ii j6 misses News and Contact Us; ja-impact wp7 misses Events and Blog and carries Authors and Login; ja-phio j6 is clean. A hidden listing that breaks the rule is to do and Publish refuses LISTING_INCOMPLETE naming the pages; a published one only warns, stays published and nothing is refused. Opening a template whose page re-read lands first draws the Listing form, not Reading….
